subject: Giant Bat
picture: A giant bat hangs from a cave ceiling by both feet. Round mouse-like head, short snout, huge ears, two leathery wings folded or half open as large shapes. Not a stirge, no needle face, no dragon snout. Cave ceiling with simple stalactites, rock walls, large floor stones, closed tunnel. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
